title: Twitter Triathlon T3 TT WheelTop TX-TT7110
notes: Current exact-model manufacturer page for the 9.5 kg RS 60 mm carbon-rim T3 TT build. It publishes a six-size geometry table, high-modulus carbon frame and fork, fully internal routing, threaded T47×24 bottom bracket, WheelTop TX-TT7110 2×12 drivetrain, Shimano 105 R7100 crank/cassette, 700×28C fitted tires and a US$2,349 made-to-order route. It does not publish maximum tire clearance, frame-only weight or a measured stiffness protocol.
